breaking_changes: Model version format changed from X.Y.Z (e.g. 11.9.0) to YYYY.WW.N (e.g. 2026.39.0) or YYYY.WW.0~<count>.<hash>; tools and scripts that parse --version output or compare version strings need updating.

The /models and /pull/variants API endpoints now serialize registry_source as an empty string instead of 'huggingface' for models without an explicit source override; clients that assume registry_source is always 'huggingface' or 'modelscope' will see '' and may misinterpret it.
The unversioned /docs endpoint subtree now returns a JSON 404 instead of falling through to the SPA web-app; anyone relying on that fallback will receive a 404.

evidence.blockers: Two P0 items need clearing before shipping: (1) the gpt-oss-120b model loads the wrong checkpoint file if the glob-to-filename fix didn't land in the release candidate artifact, and (2) auto-evict with llama.cpp silently destroys the prompt cache on soft-idle transitions, causing unnecessary reprefills and VRAM thrashing. Both are regressions to existing user setups.
evidence.breaking_changes: Three user-facing breaking changes ship in this release. The version format change is the most impactful — any tooling parsing --version output needs updating. The registry_source empty-string serialization affects clients that hardcode expected source values. The /docs 404 behavior change only affects anyone relying on the undocumented SPA fallback at the unversioned path.
evidence.coverage: All 46 commits reviewed. Range from v11.9.0 through 6ce8205 (release branch tip). The digest covers every PR and merge commit in this bucket including infrastructure, backend updates, new features, and CI changes. No PR is missing from the digest.
evidence.manual_testing: New features requiring human verification: wildcard CORS origin matching (6a5e307), the new bundled docs API and MCP tool (304d27f), session header relay to cloud providers (8312c1a), the new /images/edit endpoint (378622d), the FLM ModelScope download path (92037d8), and the new release-candidate publishing infrastructure (658d565, bfb9dd5, d7ddd10, 6e2b5bd). The new version format stamping (c47aa2a) should also be confirmed on the actual candidate build.
evidence.security: No security issues observed. The allowed_origins wildcard matching (6a5e307) was reviewed by a security-area maintainer with strict dot-boundary enforcement. The MCP client endpoints that were reverted (496bb24) improve security posture by removing an arbitrary process-launching route. The session header relay (8312c1a) uses a strict allowlist and excludes telemetry headers. All supply-chain dependency bumps include SHA256 verification.
